**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Distinguish the config-load crash from Turbopack failure**

On Node 22.23.3, the benchmark shows all three builders crashing while loading `next.config`, before any bundler is selected; only Node 22.22.0 reaches Turbopack and demonstrates its `next/package.json` resolution failure. Saying the default Turbopack fails on both versions therefore misattributes the newer-node failure and obscures the measured node-versus-bundler boundary; retain the split explanation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L252-L255](https://github.com/ejc3/node-monorepo-perf/blob/1165190a831a4de1ada0fa09ead775da6a483b9a/AGENTS.md#L252-L255)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

NOT-A-DEFECT: documentation correction, fixed in 613246a. README now reads: "`next build` under PnP: on node 22.23.3 every builder crashes loading `next.config` before a bundler is chosen; on 22.22.0 webpack and rspack build and Turbopack fails to resolve `next/package.json`." Matches bench/rspack-pnp-bench.json (config-load crash on the bench's node; turbopack resolution failure, webpack/rspack built, on the control node).
